name: Ike Fit
learned: camera height is not a customer confidence requirement
shared experimental masks may not suppress proven detectors
nested asset uploads are unreliable on iPad web workflow
Captain time is reserved for changed behavior and promotion judgment
fleet learning transfer requires mission adaptation and deliberate adoption

learned.lesson: For irregular physical products, safe layout should be derived from a face grid or shape-aware corridor rather than a single bounding rectangle; mission adapters set occupancy and placement targets.
